phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main text Fig. 1(a) and caption, p. 3

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Appendix C4 Fig. 8 and caption, p. 17

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Appendix E3 Fig. 13(a-b), Eqs. (E8)-(E14) and text, pp. 27-28

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main text Fig. 3(a) and Appendix F, pp. 6 and 29
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Large-supercell DFT Gamma-point irreps and energies are tracked across commensurate twist indices.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main text Fig. 3(b) and Appendix F, pp. 6 and 29
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The intervalley K splitting is extracted from paper-scale DFT at multiple commensurate twist indices.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The K gap decreases from i=6 to i=10 and then increases as the twist angle is reduced further, reaching a non-negligible sub-meV scale.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: A table of direct K gaps for the reported commensurate structures with energy, basis and k-point convergence.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Appendix F Fig. 14 and text, p. 29

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Appendix F Fig. 15 and caption, pp. 29-30

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Appendix B1 Eqs. (B10)-(B16), pp. 9-10
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Three dominant interlayer momentum transfers connect the two Dirac-layer bases and yield the continuum Moire Hamiltonian after nondimensionalization.

phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Independent matrix-element construction tests for Hermiticity, reciprocal embedding covariance, C3-related couplings and dimensionless spectral collapse at fixed alpha.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Appendix B2-B4 Eqs. (B17)-(B24) and Appendix C3, pp. 11-13 and 16-17
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Exact matrix identities for C3z, C2x, C2zT and approximate particle-hole operations constrain high-symmetry eigenstates of the one-valley Moire Hamiltonian.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: With the particle-hole approximation, isolated middle bands must have irreps Gamma1+Gamma2, M1+M2 and K2K3; the particle-hole operator anticommutes with C2x and pins an unpaired K2K3 representation to zero energy.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Random-k symmetry residuals, particle-hole anticommutation/spectral-pairing residuals and independent high-symmetry representation eigenvalue checks across isolated phases.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Appendix D1-D2 Eqs. (D1)-(D12), pp. 19-20
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: In a C2T-real gauge the occupied Wilson loop lies in O(n); its loop homotopy reduces the two-band integer winding to its parity after adding trivial bands.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: A two-band Wilson loop with odd winding represents the nontrivial element of pi_1(O(n))=Z2 for n>2 and remains nontrivial under superposition and hybridization with trivial bands.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: An algebraic verification of the real-gauge Wilson constraint and a constructive finite-matrix homotopy/parity test for odd and even windings with appended trivial dimensions.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Appendix D5 Eqs. (D14)-(D31), Fig. 11 and Table V, pp. 22-25
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Bent Wilson paths through symmetry-invariant momenta relate endpoint Wilson eigenvalues to C3 and C2 representation matrices.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: For a disconnected two-band set with irreps Gamma1+Gamma2, M1+M2 and K2K3, symmetry forces a nonzero Wilson winding of the form 3n+/-1; Table V gives the corresponding winding congruences for all allowed two-band irrep combinations.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Independent symbolic endpoint-matrix checks and numerical bent-loop examples for every Table V row, including the 3n+/-1 case central to the paper.
